t: The FireAngel One Smart Heat Alarm is designed to detect fire using thermal sensors. This battery-powered unit is suitable for fitting alarms in kitchens, attics and garages where smoke detectors might trigger false alerts. FireAngel One devices connect via Bluetooth to interlink up to 20 devices wirelessly or via the Angel Connect app and features a 10-year sealed lithium battery to last the lifetime of the alarm.
